motives.label: Protect people affected by the case

questions.text: The housing register defines red marks as scheduled stove inspections. The marks predate Valenti’s accusation. Choose the recorded meaning.
Nella: “I use two notes to tell my father the kettle is ready. I heard the same two notes by the stove. I never saw an attacker.” Select her direct report.
The inspection register accounts for the marks; the kettle signal accounts for the whistle. The stove report records a blocked flue. Which explanation fits all three without inventing an attacker?
Valenti wants an accusation. The residents want a functioning stove and an accurate record. Choose what work to carry forward.
The flue report calls for clearing the blockage and testing smoke flow before the stove is used. Arrange those steps.
Which sentence can both investigators sign?
The residents get an identified danger and a documented response. Valenti remains suspicious. A completed investigation need not manufacture agreement or a larger villain.
What cause did the inspector directly check?
